arguments.context:
# Goal
Compare the internals of four open-source iOS herdr clients for a user who supervises omp agents on a single Linux devbox from an iPhone. The user already has Drover working. We need a deep technical comparison: transport, herdr integration depth, transcript rendering, notifications, security, host requirements.

# Constraints
- READ-ONLY research; no edits.
- Use the `read` tool on URLs (GitHub repo files via https://github.com/<owner>/<repo>/raw/... or the github-repo API method that `read` supports for github URLs; also raw.githubusercontent.com paths work).
- Do NOT run any commands on the devbox or modify anything.
- Report facts with file paths/evidence; mark inferences.

# Contract
Each scout returns a compressed structured summary (max ~400 words) for one repo covering the question list. Include exact mechanism names, protocol details, file paths where relevant.

tasks.task:
Research the internals of the Drover iOS app: github.com/keinstn/drover (MIT, Flutter).
Read: CLAUDE.md, docs/herdr-notes.md, docs/ per-agent notes if readable, and skim app/lib structure (file listing) plus any transport/spike code references in README (app/tool/spike.dart mentioned).
Answer:
1. How does it talk to herdr — which herdr CLI commands does it invoke over SSH, or does it use the socket API? What SSH library (Dart ssh package)?
2. How does it get transcript history (integration native sessions vs pane-text fallback) and how does it parse/render agent output (chat turn-splitting, TUI chrome stripping)? Which agents are supported for native transcripts?
3. How do permission prompts become tappable buttons — what text/signature does it detect?
4. Notification path — Firebase functions backend: what exactly leaves the device, what does the relay see, E2E encryption or not? What is the drover.notify herdr plugin (separate repo keinstn/drover-notify) doing?
5. Voice dictation and photo attach internals.
6. Any documented limitations/rough edges.
tasks.name: DroverInternals

tasks.task:
Research the internals of the Heeler iOS app: github.com/ZingerLittleBee/Heeler (Apache 2.0, Swift).
Read: AGENTS.md, CONTEXT.md, docs/adr/ (try to list or fetch individual ADR files, e.g. docs/adr/README or numbered files), docs/guides/vps-jump-host.md if readable, plugin/README.md, PRIVACY.md.
Answer:
1. Transport details: direct-streamlocal channels onto herdr.sock — which API calls, how the event stream works, how `herdr agent attach --takeover` runs on an SSH PTY.
2. Console data model: what herdr JSON API fields drive the agent list (states, sessions, workspaces) — any session/workspace switching UI?
3. Composer internals: how a message is sent (direct input typing? agent prompt API?), Skills/Snippets features.
4. E2E-encrypted push notification architecture: relay design, what the relay can/cannot see, Live Activities.
5. QR pairing: plugin invoke heeler.pair — what the code carries, key generation.
6. libghostty terminal integration details, takeover semantics, attachments over SFTP.
7. Worktrees feature, jump hosts, documented rough edges/limitations.
tasks.name: HeelerInternals

tasks.task:
Research the internals of the Whip mobile app: github.com/kosumic/whip (AGPL-3.0, React Native + Rust core).
Read: ARCHITECTURE.md at repo root, plus README.md lines 301-588 (the elided part about iOS install, how it works, performance, architecture sections), PRIVACY.md briefly.
Answer:
1. The Rust core: what does it do (SSH? herdr protocol?), how does the RN frontend talk to it?
2. Which herdr surface does Whip speak — CLI over SSH, socket API, or its own protocol? How does it manage workspaces/tabs/panes (it can create/rename/split/close per README)?
3. Chat View transport for Codex and OpenCode: how it reads native transcripts (codex rollout records, opencode durable events) — over the same SSH connection? Local parse?
4. Offline capabilities: read-only virtual herdr backend cache, per-terminal outbox — how do they work?
5. whipair QR pairing: what the one-time code does, how pubkey authorization happens.
6. Notification/speech alert internals (local only?).
7. iOS unsigned-build situation specifics.
tasks.name: WhipInternals

tasks.task:
Research the internals of the Multiplex app: github.com/multiplex-term/Multiplex (Apache 2.0, Swift).
Read: DESIGN.md, AGENTS.md, docs/store-metadata.md (Pro feature gating), and the mpx-cli companion repo github.com/multiplex-term/mpx-cli README.
Answer:
1. Deck probing: how hosts are probed concurrently, how sessions become live tiles (capture-pane based?), how herdr sessions appear alongside tmux.
2. Agent awareness: how it detects Claude Code, Codex, Pi, Grok Build, Antigravity, Hermes — signature scanning of pane output? How questions/permissions/completions are surfaced.
3. mpx bind handshake: QR/local announcement with PIN, what the default handshake moves, host key pinning.
4. SSH stack details (Citadel + swift-nio-ssh pinned versions, why), clean-room mosh client status.
5. What exactly is behind Multiplex Pro IAP (store-metadata.md).
6. iPhone-specific shell vs visionOS/iPad; Shortcuts/widgets; iCloud Keychain host sync.
7. Documented rough edges.
tasks.name: MultiplexInternals
